note: Maps a Minecraft language code to a font file in fonts/ that generate_pack.py picks automatically when --font isn't given. To add a language: download an open-source font covering its script (see fonts/README.md for sources), drop the file into fonts/, then add one line below: "<language_code>": "<filename in fonts/>". Only list languages that need something other than the default Latin-script fallback (system fonts / Monocraft.ttf) -- don't add de_de, fr_fr, es_es, etc. here, they already work with no entry. --font on the command line always overrides this map.
